Application Data.NAME: Smith & Co. Barber Shop
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Co. Barber Shop provides a wide range of grooming services including haircuts, hair coloring, beard trims, and styling for men, women, and children. Our experienced team is dedicated to maintaining a clean and welcoming environment, ensuring the highest standards of hygiene and customer service. We utilize only FDA-approved products and adhere to all state regulations regarding sanitation and client safety. Regular training is provided to our staff on the latest trends and techniques in the barbering and beauty industry, as well as compliance with health and safety protocols. We prioritize customer satisfaction and engagement, fostering a loyal client base through quality service and community involvement.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 10, 2023, a client slipped and fell in the salon, resulting in a $2,000 claim for medical expenses. The claim has been settled. Additionally, on April 15, 2022, an employee experienced a minor burn from a hot styling tool, leading to a $500 claim for treatment, which was also settled. Both incidents were promptly addressed with safety training revisions.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday - Saturday: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras and a monitored alarm system are in place, with periodic inspections conducted to ensure compliance and maintenance of safety protocols.
